name: Phoenix Festooned Vehicle
description: During every holiday celebration, float parades are an important way to celebrate. The bustling streets are crowded with people and there are a dazzling array of floats, making it very lively. Zui Nishang is a fine product among the floats. It is resplendent all over, like a phoenix chariot in a palace, with a flying phoenix spreading its wings at the front and hundreds of flowers blooming all around, symbolizing the prosperous Hua'an. The colorful lanterns were hung high on the car, the tent fringes were swaying, and the stunning dancers twirled and jumped to the sound of pipa, singing and dancing, and celebrated the grand ceremony with thousands of people.
